description: This source file defines the LandingLogin React component responsible for rendering a login page with form handling and navigation. It imports React hooks, a login API utility, and routing functions. It manages state for email, password, error, and submission status, and defines an onSubmit handler to authenticate users and navigate upon success.

methods.name: LandingLogin
methods.description: React functional component rendering a login page with form handling, authentication logic, and navigation.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Asynchronous event handler for form submission that performs user login and redirects.
